result.Description:
Security researchers at Check Point Research discovered a malicious package called ascii2text impersonating the PyPI package art. PyPI has since removed ascii2text.
References
https://pypi.org/project/ascii2text/
https://research.checkpoint.com/2022/cloudguard-spectral-detects-several-malicious-packages-on-pypi-the-official-software-repository-for-python-developers/
